resolution.title: [202012][Arista] Update platform library submodules
resolution.description:
- Fix `Chassis.get_name` to return the same value than what's in `platform.json`
 - Fix `Chassis.get_system_eeprom_info` when running from within pmon.
 - Fix `Watchdog.get_remaining_time` (fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8440 and https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8439)
 - Implement missing thermal infos and conditions (fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8453)
 - Fix `Chassis.set_status_led` return value (fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8464)
